description: Wire e2e_scenarios.py into the supervisor daemon config (supervisord_sentinel_full.conf) for continuous validation. Per spec Appendix A, e2e_scenarios.py covers three canonical flows: new MCP → signal scored → verdict → attestation → UI visible. This integration ensures the e2e harness runs automatically against the live pipeline. Must NOT regenerate e2e_scenarios.py; this directive creates the integration shim that calls e2e_scenarios.run_scenario() on a schedule managed by assessment_scheduler.
